newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bertelsmann saw poor profit in digital TV.
newsitem.headline: Bertelsmann saw poor profit in digital TV.

text.p: Bertelsmann AG decided to bail out of the digital-television business because it saw little chance of profit, director Michael Dornemann said.
"I would not want to put Bertelsmann in profit difficulties just to support Leo Kirch," Dornemann said in an interview with Focus magazine.
Bertelsmann and its partner, Luxembourg-based CLT, announced last week they would withdraw from the German digital TV market, ceding the field to media mogul Kirch alone.

But things will not be easy for Kirch either. The Munich-based broadcaster said on Friday it has only about 5,500 subscribers for its digital TV service. In July, it said it aimed to have 200,000 by year-end.
